We need to propose retrosynthesis route using templates in order: 324324, then 1914396, then 733. Must have at least 3 reactions, so exactly 3 reactions using those templates sequentially. Need to construct JSON tree: root molecule target, child reaction using template 324324, its children are precursors (molecules). Then each precursor may be further broken down with next template etc. Likely linear route: each reaction splits one molecule into two precursors, then one of those is further broken down.

We need to apply templates to see what precursors they generate. Use apply_template tool for each step.

First apply template 324324 to target SMILES.
